title: arc new-story spec — the answers a story is created from
description: Input to tools/new-story.py, not a canon file. Every property is an answer about the story; there is deliberately no property for an id, slug, filename, era or status, because arc derives all of those. Unlike the canon schemas this one never validates anything on disk in a story — validate.py's schema_for() selects by file location, so a schema that maps to no canon path is inert there and only this tool loads it.

logline.description: one or two sentences: what the book is

setting.description: free text, in the author's words — roughly where and when

pov.description: may be an open question this early

period.description: when the story happens; becomes its era

name.description: what to call this stretch of time

backstory_start.description: emits an off-page era from here to the day before `start`, so dates before page one have somewhere to anchor. Required in practice whenever anyone is born before the story opens.

protagonist.description: the character the story starts with

at_start.description: what is true of them when the book opens; becomes their first state

species.description: defaults to human; animals are characters too

place.description: where the story opens, when the author has said
